QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Enemies No More
QuestInfo.0: You saved Stone Colossus and confirmed the great spirit Guwaru will not stand on the side of the Black Mage. Talk to #bValerie#k at #bStone Colossus Arm#k.
QuestInfo.1: Valerie is happy with the great harvest in this Alliance mission and is going to report to Neinheart. Go to the #bExplorer Base#k and tell #bLavi#k that everything has been resolved.
QuestInfo.2: That is how the good Stone Colossus regained peace.

0.0: Hehe, what a great harvest on this mission. We found out the identity of Stone Colossus and became friends, got rid of the Black Mage's pollution, and got crucial information from the Commander--I mean, former Commander!
0.1: Now that we know #bGuwaru doesn't support the Black Mage#k, we know his reach has been weakened! Although it doesn't seem like he was all that concerned with expanding his reach to begin with.
0.2: Like Guwaru said, the #rBlack Mage is up to something big#k. I guess the Alliance will have to investigate.
0.3: I'm going to Ereve and report to Neinheart. But you need to pass the word along at the #bExplorer Base#k, right?
0.4: Fine. I'll go by myself and tell them all about your heroic actions! See you later!

yes.0: It will take some time to get down the mountain, but my stomach can't stand the trip down on the vehicle. *sob* I'll just walk.

no.0: Do you still have something to say?

1.0: You're here. How was it? Did you meet Stone Colossus?

yes.0: What? You managed to communicate with Stone Colossus? That's remarkable! I wish I could too, but it would be too difficult to get there with all those monsters around...
yes.1: Huh? Oh, I'm so glad to hear the monster population is under control! I should call back the expedition members that left. Now we can really explore!
yes.2: I should also tell Tatamo that he can relax. Things worked out well, thanks to you! If you ever decide you'd like to join the expedition, you're always welcome!

default.0: Glad it worked out! Tell Lavi in the Explorer Base as well! I'm sure he'll be happy!
